title: Wire a real classifier into run-epic: a jev.Client needs a credential source the operator must choose
body: w9b made the classification exchange injectable (reconcile.Options.Classifier, satisfied by *jev.Client), but internal/cli builds no client, so no production run classifies anything yet. Wiring needs a TypeSafe AI API-key source (env var, ~/.ticfacrc key, or factory secret), and credentials and their grade are an always-ask item — the operator should pick where the key lives and at what grade before this becomes load-bearing. The work-type-to-model table (tick mrn) is already in factory config beside it.
